title: Henchir Guessès
description: Gsell reports remains of a large Byzantine citadel at this site, along with tombs, remains of an aqueduct, a Christian chapel, and other evidence of settlement both inside and outside the fortifications. He considers that some of the remains may be later.

properties.description: 1:1 million scale representative point location digitized from the Barrington Atlas of the Greek and Roman World by the Digital Atlas of Roman and Medieval Civilizations project at Harvard University.
